set -e
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t uclampset) == builtin ]] || exit 125
probe=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/clamp-runtime-devices-uclamp-observer-r1-r2.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$probe" read "$$" >"$HOME/cmd-before.json" || exit 125
set +e
uclampset -m 100 -M 800 /usr/bin/python3 -I "$probe" child 'a b' '' >"$HOME/cmd-child.out" 2>"$HOME/cmd-child.err"
printf '%s\n' "$?" >"$HOME/cmd-child.status"
uclampset -m 100 /tmp/parity-case/absent-uclamp-command >"$HOME/cmd-missing.out" 2>"$HOME/cmd-missing.err"
printf '%s\n' "$?" >"$HOME/cmd-missing.status"
uclampset -m 100 printf '%s\n' 'builtin result' >"$HOME/cmd-builtin.out" 2>"$HOME/cmd-builtin.err"
printf '%s\n' "$?" >"$HOME/cmd-builtin.status"
/usr/bin/python3 "$probe" read "$$" >"$HOME/cmd-after.json" || exit 125
set -e
/usr/bin/python3 /tmp/parity-case/command-judge.py
printf complete > "$HOME/clamp-body-completed-r2"

set -e
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t uclampset) == builtin ]] || exit 125
SEQ=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/clamp-system-sequence-r2.py
P=/tmp/parity-case/proc/sys/kernel
mkproc() { /usr/bin/rm -rf /tmp/parity-case/proc; /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$P"; printf '32\n' >"$P/sched_util_clamp_min"; printf '512\n' >"$P/sched_util_clamp_max"; }
# run LABEL "SEQ-RULES" "COMMAND" ; prints status, stderr probes, file values and the ordered open/write trace
run() {
  local T=$HOME/$1 rules=$2 cmd=$3
  /usr/bin/rm -f "$T".log "$T".err "$T".rc
  BASHOS_PROC_ROOT=/tmp/parity-case/proc /usr/bin/python3 "$SEQ" --notify openat --log-string openat=1 --notify write --log-args write=0,2 --log-mem write=1:4 $rules --log "$T.log" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$cmd 2>$T.err; printf 'rc=%s\\n' \$? >$T.rc"
  /usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/clamp_r2_support.py --verify-outcome "$T.log" || exit 125
  local rc=$(<"$T.rc") mn mx; read -r mn <"$P/sched_util_clamp_min"; read -r mx <"$P/sched_util_clamp_max"
  echo "$1: ${rc} min=$mn max=$mx"
  /usr/bin/python3 -I - "$T" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
t = sys.argv[1]
ev = []
for l in open(t + ".log"):
    r = json.loads(l)
    if r["syscall"] == "openat":
        s = str(r.get("string1", ""))
        if "sched_util_clamp_" in s:
            ev.append("open " + s.rsplit("_", 1)[1])
    elif r["syscall"] == "write":
        data = bytes.fromhex(r["memory1"]["hex"])[:r["arg2"]]
        if re.fullmatch(rb"[0-9]+\n", data):
            ev.append("write %s%s" % (data.decode().strip(), "" if r["reply"] == "continue" else "[" + r["reply"] + "]"))
print("  trace: " + (" | ".join(ev) or "(none)"))
err = open(t + ".err").read().strip().splitlines()
for line in err:
    print("  err: " + line.replace("/tmp/parity-case/proc/sys/kernel/", "P/"))
PY
}
mkproc; /usr/bin/chmod 444 "$P/sched_util_clamp_max"
run omax "" "uclampset -m 64 -M 768 --system"
mkproc; /usr/bin/chmod 444 "$P/sched_util_clamp_min"
run omin "" "uclampset -m 64 -M 768 --system"
printf complete > "$HOME/clamp-body-completed-r2"

cases.oracle: Documented uclampset --system contract (open all changed files before the first write, raise the ceiling first when the new floor exceeds it, roll back in reverse order, short write is EIO), a private BASHOS_PROC_ROOT tree and a seccomp-notify syscall log (helpers/clamp-system-sequence-r2.py)
cases.comparison: ENOSPC injected on the second write of each order: reverse-order restore writes, final values equal the originals, diagnostic names the failing file. (A /dev/full symlink cannot be used: the pre-read of that file must parse.)
cases.stdout:
rb1: rc=1 min=32 max=512
  trace: open min | open max | open min | open max | write 64 | write 768[errno:28] | write 512 | write 32
  err: uclampset: cannot write P/sched_util_clamp_max: No space left on device
rb2: rc=1 min=32 max=512
  trace: open min | open max | open max | open min | write 800 | write 600[errno:28] | write 32 | write 512
  err: uclampset: cannot write P/sched_util_clamp_min: No space left on device

files.clamp-r2-body.sh:
set -e
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t uclampset) == builtin ]] || exit 125
SEQ=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/clamp-system-sequence-r2.py
P=/tmp/parity-case/proc/sys/kernel
mkproc() { /usr/bin/rm -rf /tmp/parity-case/proc; /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$P"; printf '32\n' >"$P/sched_util_clamp_min"; printf '512\n' >"$P/sched_util_clamp_max"; }
# run LABEL "SEQ-RULES" "COMMAND" ; prints status, stderr probes, file values and the ordered open/write trace
run() {
  local T=$HOME/$1 rules=$2 cmd=$3
  /usr/bin/rm -f "$T".log "$T".err "$T".rc
  BASHOS_PROC_ROOT=/tmp/parity-case/proc /usr/bin/python3 "$SEQ" --notify openat --log-string openat=1 --notify write --log-args write=0,2 --log-mem write=1:4 $rules --log "$T.log" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$cmd 2>$T.err; printf 'rc=%s\\n' \$? >$T.rc"
  /usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/clamp_r2_support.py --verify-outcome "$T.log" || exit 125
  local rc=$(<"$T.rc") mn mx; read -r mn <"$P/sched_util_clamp_min"; read -r mx <"$P/sched_util_clamp_max"
  echo "$1: ${rc} min=$mn max=$mx"
  /usr/bin/python3 -I - "$T" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
t = sys.argv[1]
ev = []
for l in open(t + ".log"):
    r = json.loads(l)
    if r["syscall"] == "openat":
        s = str(r.get("string1", ""))
        if "sched_util_clamp_" in s:
            ev.append("open " + s.rsplit("_", 1)[1])
    elif r["syscall"] == "write":
        data = bytes.fromhex(r["memory1"]["hex"])[:r["arg2"]]
        if re.fullmatch(rb"[0-9]+\n", data):
            ev.append("write %s%s" % (data.decode().strip(), "" if r["reply"] == "continue" else "[" + r["reply"] + "]"))
print("  trace: " + (" | ".join(ev) or "(none)"))
err = open(t + ".err").read().strip().splitlines()
for line in err:
    print("  err: " + line.replace("/tmp/parity-case/proc/sys/kernel/", "P/"))
PY
}
mkproc; run rb1 "--reply-seq write=continue,ENOSPC" "uclampset -m 64 -M 768 --system"
mkproc; run rb2 "--reply-seq write=continue,ENOSPC" "uclampset -m 600 -M 800 --system"
printf complete > "$HOME/clamp-body-completed-r2"
